sql: SELECT MAX(month) AS latest_complete_month FROM (SELECT month FROM marts.fct_risk_index_monthly GROUP BY month HAVING COUNT(risk_index) >= 43) AS m LIMIT 500

WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(month) AS month FROM (SELECT month FROM marts.fct_risk_index_monthly GROUP BY month HAVING COUNT(risk_index) >= 43) AS m) SELECT COUNT(*) AS counties_drier_than_usual FROM marts.fct_risk_index_monthly AS r JOIN latest AS l ON r.month = l.month WHERE r.risk_index > 0.5 LIMIT 500
SELECT share_phase3plus FROM marts.fct_ipc_county_analysis WHERE county_name = 'Turkana' ORDER BY analysis_month DESC LIMIT 1

WITH months AS (SELECT month FROM marts.fct_risk_index_monthly GROUP BY month HAVING COUNT(risk_index) >= 43 ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT 3) SELECT r.county_name FROM marts.fct_risk_index_monthly AS r JOIN months USING (month) GROUP BY r.county_name HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE r.risk_index > 0.5) = 3 LIMIT 500
SELECT county_name, forecast_kes_per_kg, lower_80_kes_per_kg, upper_80_kes_per_kg FROM marts.fct_price_forecast WHERE horizon = 3 ORDER BY change_pct DESC LIMIT 500

WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(analysis_month) AS analysis_month FROM marts.fct_ipc_county_analysis) SELECT i.county_name FROM marts.fct_ipc_county_analysis AS i JOIN latest AS l ON i.analysis_month = l.analysis_month ORDER BY i.share_phase3plus DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT month FROM marts.fct_risk_index_monthly WHERE month >= CAST('2015-01-01' AS DATE) AND risk_index >= 0.8 GROUP BY month ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, month DESC LIMIT 1

WITH months AS (SELECT month FROM marts.fct_risk_index_monthly GROUP BY month HAVING COUNT(risk_index) >= 43 ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT 12) SELECT r.county_name FROM marts.fct_risk_index_monthly AS r JOIN months USING (month) GROUP BY r.county_name ORDER BY AVG(r.risk_index) DESC LIMIT 500

WITH months AS (SELECT month FROM marts.fct_risk_index_monthly GROUP BY month HAVING COUNT(risk_index) >= 43 ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT 3), ranked AS (SELECT r.month, r.county_name, r.risk_index, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.month ORDER BY r.risk_index DESC) AS rk FROM marts.fct_risk_index_monthly AS r JOIN months USING (month)) SELECT month, county_name FROM ranked WHERE rk <= 3 LIMIT 500
SELECT county_name FROM marts.fct_ipc_county_analysis WHERE share_phase3plus >= 0.2 GROUP BY county_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 LIMIT 500
